title: Which connectors do your agents' sessions have?
detail: Their ABPs are in content/abp/ (drafts from the repository alone). Two things only you can answer: can procurement@web-summit.silvio's mail connection send, or only draft? Whose calendar does team-collaboration@web-summit.angelo use, and can it invite people? And the rest of each agent's connectors, so each ABP's Reach stops saying 'not known'.
